channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE nega remoção de vídeo que chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'mentiroso Master'
item.description: The TSE rejected a request to remove a video from Lula's campaign calling Flávio Bolsonaro a 'Master liar'. The decision keeps the post under review regarding allegations against the PL candidate.

item.title: Confisco de panela no panelaço é ensaio para celular de jornalista em 2027
item.description: A doorman and a resident were arrested for using a pan during a 'pan protest' against Flávio Bolsonaro while he gave an interview to Jornal Nacional in Maceió. The case was seen as a test for the confiscation of journalists' phones in 2027.

item.title: Alckmin, Haddad e Tebet participam de caminhada pró-Lula em Heliópolis
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin and former ministers Fernando Haddad and Simone Tebet participated in a pro-Lula walk in Heliópolis, São Paulo, engaging with residents and supporters. The event, named 'Caminhada da Virada', aims to boost Lula's performance in the second round. Alckmin received 56.6% of votes in Heliópolis in the first round, compared to 34.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Justiça rejeita pedido de advogado ligado a Flávio contra a Blaze
item.description: São Paulo's court rejected lawyer Willer Tomaz's request, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, to recover R$133.2 million lost in bets on the Blaze platform. The judge ruled that Tomaz voluntarily assumed the risks and sought special conditions to place high-value bets. The decision favored Blaze, denying compensation to the lawyer.

item.title: Flávio tem 51,2% contra 48,8% de Lula, diz Ipespe/Abrapel
item.description: A 2026 Ipespe/Abrapel poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 51.2% against Lula (PT) at 48.8% in the second round, within the margin of error. The poll, covering 1,500 voters and registered with the TSE, indicates a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: O bolsonarista não aguenta um google
item.description: The text depicts a heated conversation between a Bolsonaro supporter and his uncle about political preferences, highlighting communication challenges across generations and ideologies. The debate touches on gun control, public safety, and cultural funding, illustrating difficulties in discussing policies based on verifiable facts.

item.title: São Paulo x Vasco no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: São Paulo and Vasco face off on Saturday, 17, at 21:00 (Brasília time) at Morumbis in the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. São Paulo seeks stability under pressure on Dorival Júnior, while Vasco enters with an advantage from the Sudamericana. The match will be broadcast on Sportv and Premiere.

item.title: Grass promete regularização e saúde e diz que futuro do DF está em jogo
item.description: During a walk in Vila Planalto, PT candidate Leandro Grass promised to legalize land, improve healthcare and boost the local economy. He plans to issue property deeds, renovate historic buildings and turn the neighborhood into a tourist hub to create jobs and preserve the history of the Federal District.

item.title: Esperança ou medo: qual sentimento domina a disputa entre Flávio e Lula, segundo nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: A new Ipespe/Abrapel survey reveals hope as the dominant sentiment among voters (47%), followed by fear (15%), maintaining the trend from the previous round. Among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, hope leads with 59%, while among Lula voters, despite leading (37%), it is significantly accompanied by fear (23%).

item.title: As mentiras da Globo sobre os áudios de Vorcaro denunciando Lula
item.description: Globo and its media outlets have been discrediting a VEJA report featuring Daniel Vorcaro's audios, alleging a 30 million reais payment to Lula's Institute and funding for Oliver Stone's documentary. The Federal Police and Public Ministry issued statements to cast doubt, but Vorcaro's lawyer and sister confirmed the authenticity of the audios, backed by a forensic report showing no editing. The case was also referenced by Flávio Bolsonaro in a televised debate, where he was interrupted while discussing it.

item.title: Qual campanha está se saindo melhor nas redes, nas ruas e em entrevistas, segundo nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: The latest Ipespe/Abrapel poll indicates that Flávio Bolsonaro holds a slight lead over Lula across all platforms evaluated, particularly on social media, where 45% of voters consider his campaign the best. The gap between the candidates narrowed compared to the previous poll, but Flávio remains ahead on TV, radio, WhatsApp, and interviews. Lula maintains steady support but does not surpass the senator in any medium.

item.title: A boa notícia para Lula a oito dias do segundo turno na nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: Lula's approval rose from 43% to 45% in the latest Ipespe poll, while disapproval fell from 50% to 48%, narrowing the negative gap from 7 to 3 percentage points. Among Lula's voters, 88% approve the government, but 93% of Flávio's supporters reject it. The race remains tight, with Flávio leading 51.2% of valid votes against Lula's 48.8%.

item.title: Datafolha: 80% apoiam redução da maioridade penal
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 80% of Brazilians support reducing the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, the lowest support level since 2003. Among Flávio Bolsonaro supporters, support reaches 89%.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Ipespe mostra quantos eleitores dizem que vão votar no segundo turno
item.description: A new Ipespe/Abrapel survey shows that 89% of voters give a score of 10 to the likelihood of voting in the runoff, with a general average of 9.5. Among those living close to their polling station, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 51% against Lula's 45%, while among those living farther away, Lula rises to 49% against Flávio's 39%. Among the most likely voters, the split is 50% for Flávio and 46% for Lula in valid votes.

item.title: Meta admite falhas que afetaram campanha de Lula, mas nega interferência política nas eleições
item.description: Meta acknowledged technical glitches that affected Lula's campaign in the 2026 elections but denied political interference, claiming the issues were global and impacted other candidates, including Flávio Bolsonaro. The company faces a lawsuit at the TSE following reports of restrictions on ad boosting and creation of electoral images.

item.title: Verde Amarelo é nosso: veja fotos da campanha convocada por Janones
item.description: André Janones led a digital campaign urging Lula's supporters to post photos wearing green and yellow and making the 'L' hand gesture on social media. Organized by the Lula Army on WhatsApp, the initiative aims to boost support for the president in the 2026 elections against Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula participated by posting a photo wearing the Brazilian national team jersey on Instagram.

item.title: A ilusão das pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The article examines how Lula's supporters mobilized after the first round based on polls that may not reflect reality, especially with Flávio Bolsonaro's rising projections. It questions the effectiveness of strategies relying solely on voting intention data.

item.title: Ipespe: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 48% e Lula marca 46% no 2º turno
item.description: Polling by Ipespe released on October 17, 2026 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 48% and Lula (PT) at 46% in the second round, with a margin of error of 2.6 points. The Liberal candidate's numerical lead is two points in the stimulated scenario, but within the margin, creating a tie. Among valid votes, Flávio leads with 51.2% against Lula's 48.8%.

item.title: Qual o peso do fim da escala 6×1 na escolha de voto no segundo turno, de acordo com nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: The new Ipespe survey shows that the end of the 6×1 scale doubled its relevance among voters, especially among young people aged 16 to 34 (33%). Among Lula voters, 20% cite the issue as the main deciding factor, while only 1% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters mention it. Corruption and crisis at the STF remain leading at 20%.

item.title: Brasil não é democracia para 16% dos eleitores, diz Datafolha
item.description: According to a Datafolha poll, 16% of Brazilian voters believe the country is not a democracy, while 50% say it has a democratic regime with major flaws. Only 7% see a fully democratic system. The survey, registered with the TSE under protocol BR-00466/2026, was conducted between October 13 and 14 with 2,520 respondents and a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Advogado amigo de Flávio recebeu documentos vazados do STJ e MPF, diz site
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz, investigated for fraud against the Pension system and friend of candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), received draft decisions from the STJ and MPF statements before publication, according to a Federal Police investigation. The information was reported by UOL.

item.title: O que pensam eleitores de Flávio e Lula sobre redução da maioridade penal, segundo pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 80% of Brazilians support lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, with 89% support among Flávio Bolsonaro voters and 70% among Lula voters. The measure remains stable compared to previous polls, with slight variation in rejection rates across age groups.

item.title: Defesa de Milton Leite se manifesta após operação contra regalias em cadeia
item.description: The former councilman Milton Leite, arrested on suspicion of involvement with the PCC, denied through his defense team that he received any privileges while in custody. His lawyers stated he is subject to the same rules as all other inmates, following the launch of the 'Custody (Un)Fiel' operation by the São Paulo State Public Ministry to investigate undue favors to politicians at Mogi das Cruzes Public Prison. The probe began after an anonymous tip alleged unauthorized visits from politicians and friends, including Valdemar Costa Neto and state deputies.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Ipespe mostra para onde vão os votos de Cury, Caiado e Renan no segundo turno
item.description: Ipespe/Abrapel poll shows Caiado voters migrated more to Flávio (59%), followed by Cury (50%) and Renan (40%). Lula and Flávio retained 96-97% of their voters. Margin of error is 2.6 percentage points.

item.title: Flávio chama rastreamento de munições de “detalhezinho”
item.description: In an interview with TV Globo, presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) downplayed the debate over removing ammunition tracking, referring to it as a 'minor detail.' The proposal, which amends the Disarmament Statute, removes the mandatory identification of cartridges, making it harder to trace munitions used by security forces. He emphasized focusing on AI and technology investments to combat organized crime.

item.title: Athletico-PR x Palmeiras no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Athletico-PR and Palmeiras face off at 19:30 at the Arena da Baixada in the 31st round of the 2026 Brasileirão. The Furacão aims to extend its lead, while the Verdão seeks to catch up with Flamengo. The match will be broadcast live on Amazon Prime Video.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Ipespe sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula a oito dias do segundo turno
item.description: A new Ipespe/Abrapel poll released eight days before the runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro at 51.2% of valid votes and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at 48.8%, with a 2.6-point margin of error. Among voters from first-round candidates, slight fluctuations within the margin of error were observed, with 97% of Flávio’s and 96% of Lula’s supporters maintaining their preferences.

item.title: Lula adere à campanha de Janones e posta foto com camisa da seleção
item.description: President Lula joined the 'Green and Yellow is Ours' campaign led by André Janones, posting a photo wearing the Brazilian national team jersey with a sticker reading 'Brazil belongs to Brazilians'. The movement seeks to dissociate national colors from Bolsonarismo, gaining support from lawmakers and artists.

item.title: Maioria dos brasileiros apoia fim da reeleição para presidente e governadores, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha survey reveals that 51% of Brazilians support ending reelection for president and governors, with 30% preferring single four-year terms and 21% favoring five-year terms without reelection. Support for maintaining reelection varies by voting intention, with Lula voters and young people favoring the current rule. A constitutional amendment proposal to eliminate reelection gains traction after being advocated by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não planeja dar um cargo ao pai se for eleito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated he does not intend to appoint his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to a government position if elected, though he has not ruled out the possibility entirely. The statement was made during a press conference where he discussed his presidential campaign.

item.title: 51% são contra reeleição e 46% defendem mais de um mandato; diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows that 51% of voters oppose reelection for presidents and governors, while 46% support more than one term. The issue gains prominence after Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) stance against reelection, with stronger support for the current model among PT voters and opposition among PL voters.

item.title: “Pega esse dedo e enfia no coração”, diz Janja a crítico em MG
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva responded to a critic during Lula's campaign rally in Ipatinga, MG, saying 'Grab that finger and stick it in your heart.' Lula warned that right-wing policies would be at risk if the opposition returns to power.

item.title: Redução de palanques locais no segundo turno desafia os presidenciáveis
item.description: On October 4th, 21 states concluded their local races in the second round, leaving only six with active contests, increasing complexity for the presidential campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The states still holding elections represent 7.9% of the electorate and could sway the national outcome.

item.title: Ação do PT contra lei de terras executada por Tarcísio é retomada no STF
item.description: The STF resumed the hearing of the PT's lawsuit challenging São Paulo's land regularization law, originally enacted in 2022 and repurposed by Tarcísio de Freitas. Minister Cármen Lúcia maintained her vote declaring the law unconstitutional, while Justice Gilmar Mendes partially dissented, upholding its constitutionality. The PT criticizes the law for allowing up to 90% discounts on public land sales, changing their intended use.

item.title: Às vésperas do segundo turno, Lula parte para o ‘tudo ou nada’ com pacote de ações eleitoreiras
item.description: Ahead of the runoff, Lula launches an R$17 billion package for self-employed workers, including tax debt forgiveness and a R$5,000 aid payment via Pix, targeting 17 million informal workers. The measure, with clear electoral bias, aims to attract dissatisfied voters and expand his support base, despite polls showing a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Defesa de Dark Horse promete perícia após eleição e prevê disputa por Oscar
item.description: The defense of production company GoUp confirmed it will conduct a new audit of Dark Horse film finances only after the elections, rejecting probes questioning the legality of funding. Lawyer Ricardo Sayeg stated confidence that the film will compete for an Oscar and that the audit will reveal the legitimacy of fundraising. The case involves allegations of $12.3 million sent to a US fund and contradictions about the money's origins.

item.title: Timing desastroso da Globo com Flávio abre crise com Lula
item.description: The meeting between Globo's leadership and Flávio Bolsonaro drew criticism from Lula, who labeled the encounter suspicious and hinted at retaliation against his government's policies. The PT bench deemed the timing politically damaging for the broadcaster, especially after Lula avoided direct comments about journalist Renata Lo Prete. The incident revives tensions between the press and the executive branch, focusing on regulatory issues such as the 6x1 workday and betting regulations.

item.title: Covid fica fora do top 10 de causas de morte pelo 3º ano em 2025
item.description: Covid-19 has been out of the top 10 leading causes of death in Brazil for the third consecutive year in 2025, with only 1,664 deaths — a 99.6% drop from the 2021 peak. By October 2026, mild and moderate cases fell by 67.2%, and deaths linked to the disease decreased by 65.8%.

item.title: Mais de 4,3 mil seções eleitorais mudaram de local para o 2º turno; veja como consultar onde votar
item.description: Over 4,300 polling stations had their voting location changed for the 2026 general election runoff, mainly due to heavy rains, last-minute renovations, and accessibility issues. Voters are advised to confirm their new address via the e-Título app or the TSE’s online self-service portal. The changes do not reduce the total number of stations and mostly affect São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Bahia.

item.title: TSE nega pedido de Flávio para proibir gravações de Lula no Alvorada
item.description: The TSE rejected a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to prohibit President Lula from recording electoral content at the official palaces. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva deemed the request generic and overly restrictive to political communication.

item.title: Flávio usa sabatina como propaganda, enaltece bolsonarismo e deixa conta do ajuste em aberto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro turned his Globo interview into campaign propaganda, evading answers on justice for January 8 coup supporters and praising Bolsonarism. He left fiscal accounts open, linking solutions to anti-corruption efforts and AI.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula advocates for democracy in a speech, highlighting the importance of dialogue despite disagreements. The statement reflects the current political climate and the country's polarization. The topic is addressed in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa "golpe da Disney" e foge das perguntas sobre a família
item.description: In a live interview on Jornal Nacional, Flávio Bolsonaro avoided directly answering questions about his father Jair Bolsonaro's potential conviction, using disputed claims like 'the trial was a farce' and deflecting from the topic. He defended his family, downplaying his father's role on January 8 and attacking opposing judges and politicians, while addressing issues like security and economy only briefly. The interview was characterized by evasive responses and controversial rhetoric.

item.title: IA de Elon Musk recusa pedidos sobre Lula e atende os de Flávio
item.description: Poder360 tested seven AI tools to create electoral artwork for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro; Grok only fulfilled the request for Flávio, while Meta AI, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude served both. The investigation follows a TSE order imposing equal treatment for both candidates under a $100,000 fine, after allegations of favoritism by Meta.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Datafolha sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula na eleição presidencial
item.description: Datafolha will release on Thursday (22) a new survey on the 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, keeping the technical tie between candidates. Beyond voting intentions, the poll will analyze candidate rejection rates, Lula’s government approval, and perceptions of the economy, next president’s priorities, and relations with the US and China.

item.title: Segurança, escala 6×1 e Milei: os temas de Lula para o debate contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula prepares for the second round debate against Flávio Bolsonaro focusing on public security, reduction of criminal responsibility age, and ties with international far-right. The PT campaign highlights proposals like the 6×1 workday reduction and criticizes Eduardo Bolsonaro's interactions with U.S. authorities.

item.title: A condição de Michelle para viajar com Flávio na campanha do 2º turno
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, elected senator from the Federal District, set a condition to travel with her nephew Flávio Bolsonaro during the 2nd round only if she can return the same day, to avoid being away from her husband, who is under house arrest in Brasília. Flávio's campaign aims to have her join events to reduce his rejection among female voters in the Northeast. In the first round, they did not hold any joint street events, with Michelle focused on her Senate campaign.

item.title: Veja as palavras mais faladas por Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula nas sabatinas à TV Globo
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participated in TV Globo interviews, with word frequency analyses showing Lula emphasizing 'Brasil', 'People', and 'Economy', while Flávio focused on 'Brasil', 'Government', and 'Lula'. Both discussed topics such as economy, security, and governance.

item.title: O que a eleição de uma estreante deputada federal de 24 anos do Rio revela sobre a onda de direita no Brasil
item.description: The election of 24-year-old influencer Julia de Castro from Rio de Janeiro reflects the rise of young right-wing figures who leverage digital political capital and are recruited by parties like the PL, reinforcing a conservative wave in Brazil.

item.title: Pergunta de milhões de dólares
item.description: The 'Dollar Question' poll shows 74% of 908 respondents believe the issue is 'turning', while 26% say 'not even standing tall'. The content features political analysis on figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, Ricardo Noblat, and topics such as criminal responsibility, security, and the 2026 elections.
